uncertain: sample: 6 bars of 2 panels, the printed share of Correct only
panel 1, bar 8 'Claude3-Haiku API', read as 50.3%: the first digit is overprinted by the '%' of the label of the bar to its left; it reads 5 on both enlargements and the bar top is at 50.4.
panel 1, bar 22 'Llama2-13b-Q5 Local', read as 33.4%: 33.4 is not a multiple of 1/300 (it is 100/299); the digit 4 is clear at 16x on both enlargements.
panel 3, bar 1 'GPT-3.5 Web', read as 44.2%: its '%' is overprinted by the label of the next bar; the digits are clear.

Scorer hazard (docling/engines/figure_data/scoring.py: labels count as equal within a Levenshtein distance of 0.2 of the longer, values pair first-fit in prediction order). By that rule, computed here on lower-cased labels, these tick labels are the same: 'Llama2-13b-Q5 Local' (bar 22) and 'Llama2-7b-Q8 Local' (bar 19): 0.16; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama2-70b Poe' (bar 23): 0.19; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3-70b Poe' (bar 27): 0.12; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3.1-8b Poe' (bar 28): 0.12; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3.1-405b Poe' (bar 30): 0.12; 'Phi3-3b-Q16 Local' (bar 36) and 'Phi3-14b-Q6 Local' (bar 37): 0.18. Against a prediction that lists all 37 bars from left to right the truth rows are then paired with an earlier bar instead of their own: bar 22 with bar 19 'Llama2-7b-Q8 Local'; bar 29 with bar 23 'Llama2-70b Poe'. Pair by exact tick label when scoring this sample.
The legend sits inside the plot area (top right) and covers the upper part of the last two bars; it is not a panel. Bar 36's Correct segment and its label lie below it.
